description: First training run on the generated maps (curriculum S0-S3, full_level shaping + coverage bonus), 4 workers x 8 envs, 8 torch threads, CPU, default seed and entropy coefficient, health monitor flag-only. Layout, flag-only monitor and time limit chosen by the coordinator: 5.0 GiB was available at launch, and the user shuts the laptop down at 17:00, so the run stops itself at about 16:43.
